rate_limits.correction: Plans have monthly request limits with no additional request-velocity throttling. The published paid plans include 1,000,000 requests per month, resetting at midnight UTC on the first of each month.

description.correction: HolidayAPI provides REST holiday and observance data for countries and paid-plan subdivisions. Documented optional filters include month, day, public, subdivisions, search, language, previous, and upcoming; no observed-date request filter is documented.

notes: Official documentation confirms the v1 endpoint, GET request, key query parameter, country/year parameters, JSON response fields, and free-key availability. The official pricing page discloses paid-plan limits and a 24-hour free-plan data-storage restriction, but the complete current free-tier request and year limits could not be verified from accessible official material.
